subject.title: EPIC · Revisión V3 — Nuevo puesto de revisión de producto

question: Should the Revision V3 umbrella stay open until the remaining analytics, hardware, and tracing children are resolved, or should maintainers explicitly split that remaining scope and close the umbrella now?
rationale: The evidence shows meaningful work remains, but some of it is operational/hardware and product-scope coordination rather than a single source-code fix automation should decide.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue as the canonical tracker until the open child issues are resolved or intentionally descoped.

options.title: Split remaining scope
options.body: Move the remaining analytics, hardware, and tracing items to a maintainer-approved tracking path, then close the umbrella only after documenting the scope cut.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue as the canonical tracker until the open child issues are resolved or intentionally descoped.

likelyOwner.reason: Alex is assigned on the epic and has the strongest recent Revision V3 PR history across the kiosk and coordination surfaces.
